quote: To evaluate the results of the generated AD post, we adopt the following widely used metrics. Embedding Metrics. To obtain semantic matches between the generated copywriting and ground-truth, we perform evaluation using the embedding metrics. Following , we calculate three measures: 1) Average, cosine similarity between the averaged word embeddings in the two utterances ; 2) Greedy, i.e., greedily matching words in two utterances based on the cosine similarities, and the total scores are then averaged across all words ; 3) Extrema, cosine similarity between the largest values among the word embeddings in the two utterances . ... Distinct Metrics. We use distinct scores to reflect the diversity of the copywriting.
